metric_definitions.clock_origins: scheduled_at = offered schedule in the run clock; sent_at = client request start; first_content_at = first content event; terminal_at = client terminal
metric_definitions.comparison_identity: measured arms must share offered trace sha256, all-offered count and envelope scope
metric_definitions.conditional_estimand: TTFT conditional on fate complete (selection-biased; read with fates and the penalized TTFT)
metric_definitions.controller_overhead: static_fixed: no controller, 0 decisions, 0.0 s with recorded basis (no fake solver cost); measured_intervals: decisions, interval union total/within envelope/fraction, duration percentiles; otherwise null with reason; never added to request latency
metric_definitions.denominator: all offered rows (one per offered request id, unique); every fate retained; rates null when zero offered
metric_definitions.groups_fairness: per-group fates/SLO/TTFT; spread worst_min/best_max/gap/min_over_max/Jain over non-empty groups for slo_attainment_fraction and delivered_fraction; Jain null for all-zero, <2 groups or unavailable metric; worst group rejection and conditional p95 with n
metric_definitions.natural_slo: unchanged r23 score_http.score (sha256 pinned) only when every row carries status/finish_reason/requested_ignore_eos/stream_done/stream_error; otherwise every SLO field null with missing reasons, no TTFT-only substitute
metric_definitions.outcomes: fates complete/rejected/http_error/stream_error/transport_error/cancelled/not_launched/unknown; rejection, failure (http/stream/transport/cancelled), not_launched and unknown rates are separate; not_launched is never merged into rejection
metric_definitions.penalized_estimand: failure-penalized operational TTFT over ALL offered requests (missing first content = +inf); NOT a survival-analysis identified quantile of right-censored latency
metric_definitions.send_lag_s: sent_at - scheduled_at over sent rows plus n_not_sent
metric_definitions.slo_goodput_rps: cohort (good / offered window, cohort-normalized (includes tail): all-offered cohort count / offered window seconds; not steady-state GPU throughput), in-window, and wall-envelope (good / envelope)
metric_definitions.throughput: offered_rps, delivered (fate complete incl. length-capped) rps per cohort window and wall envelope; completion tokens/s lower = observed usage, upper = + max_output_tokens per delivered row lacking usage, exact flag

train_selection_rule.data: Train only, identical offered trace sha256 and count
train_selection_rule.primary: natural_slo_good higher (identical offered cohort => cohort SLO goodput order)
train_selection_rule.refuse: natural SLO unavailable, non-train, non-static, mismatched trace, missing arm

metric_definitions.ttft_s: nearest-rank rank=ceil(q*n/100) for q in 50/95/99 with n, rank, is_sample_max, max; four blocks: conditional (fate complete) from scheduled and client-send origins, and all-offered failure-penalized (missing first content = +inf) from both origins; a rank on +inf gives null with p*_null_reason rank_falls_on_failure_penalty; empty gives null_reason no_samples
metric_definitions.windows: offered window, envelope, envelope_scope; full_wall_s non-null only for scope full_wall

envelope_scopes.full_wall: caller-recorded actual wall in the run clock domain including setup, solver, HTTP, unresolved requests and final drain
envelope_scopes.offered_cohort_observed: offered start to the later of offered end and last observed terminal; EXCLUDES pre-offer setup/solver warmup, post-terminal drain and unresolved requests: a lower bound on the full wall, not the full wall
